subject.title: fix(qa-channel): honor canonical thread action fields

question: Should QA-channel’s exported action adapter guarantee that canonical `target`, `threadName`, and `message` override conflicting legacy `channelId`/`threadId`/`to`, `title`, and `text` values?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent and preserves legacy-only callers, but choosing precedence for conflicting public adapter inputs is a durable compatibility policy rather than a test-only detail.

options.title: Approve canonical-first precedence
options.body: Treat shared runner fields as authoritative, retain legacy-only aliases, and merge the tested canonical-over-legacy behavior.

options.title: Preserve legacy precedence
options.body: Keep old direct-adapter fields authoritative when both forms are present, which weakens alignment with the shared action contract.

options.title: Reject ambiguous mixed inputs
options.body: Return a validation error whenever canonical and legacy forms disagree, requiring callers to migrate deliberately.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical-first precedence
recommendation.body: Treat shared runner fields as authoritative, retain legacy-only aliases, and merge the tested canonical-over-legacy behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available routing candidate with recent channel-action context, though a QA/channel-area owner should make the final compatibility decision.
